verdict.rationale: Warp's own docs describe webhooks where Warp sends an HTTPS POST to your endpoint for each event you subscribe to. They follow the Standard Webhooks specification, support verification through the SDKs, and retry up to 12 times with exponential backoff, so a programmatic consumer can clearly receive outbound callbacks. missing for 10: an explicit event-type catalog and the endpoint registration/subscription management API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Warp sends an HTTPS `POST` request to your endpoint for each event you subscribe to.
Warp implements the Standard Webhooks specification.
It makes up to 12 delivery attempts with exponential backoff starting at 30 seconds.
